critical_code_review_comments: analysis.py predict_trajectory thresholds (>120 km/h noise, <3 km/h stationary) are sensible for meso-scale cells; unit tests confirm the branches trigger correctly. Good defensive coding.
vigilance.py _fetch_open_meteo_multi: single request for 5 coordinate pairs is correct pattern for Open-Meteo — addresses the 429 root cause. No caching regression observed.

server.py _alert_watcher vigilance block (L430-458): correct 20-min throttle matches the 15-min TTL, uses Lourdes dept (65) as primary source with overall_level fallback. Only fires on escalation (>= 3 AND > prev) — prevents spam when level is already orange. Worst-phenomena label aggregation caps at 3 which is UX-friendly. Minor: no downgrade notification (not requested, just noting).

TrajectoryBadge.jsx: onClick={detected && onFit ? onFit : undefined} combined with disabled={!detected || !onFit} is belt-and-suspenders — good. The conditional 'hover:border-red-600 cursor-pointer' vs 'cursor-default' tailwind classes render cleanly; confirmed visually the disabled state does not show hover cursor.
TrajectoryBadge title attribute is only set when detected — matches current a11y best practice (avoid misleading tooltip on disabled buttons).
Minor: TrajectoryLayer.jsx fitSignal effect should be verified when a real trajectory triggers (could not test dynamically because strikes are calm). Code review only.
